(Depth -108X/198X)		 Exon 16 Heterozygous Nephrotic syndrome, type 1

INTERPRETATION 

The tested variant NPHS1 (NM_004646.4) Exon 16 [c.2105G>A (p.Gly702Glu)] was detected to be heterozygous in the analysed sample.

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Please correlate clinically
2. Genetic counseling for accurate interpretation of test results is recommended.
3. Segregation analysis of the above variants (testing of multiple affected as well as unaffected members) is recommended. Variant classification may be modified after segregation analysis.

Technical Notes
Methodology: Massively Parallel Sequencing (Next Generation Sequencing) Genomic DNA from the submitted specimen was enriched for the variants specific region as per the requested by clinician using a custom bait- capture system. Paired End Sequencing was performed. Reads were assembled and were aligned to reference sequences based on NCBI RefSeq transcripts and human genome build GRCh37/UCSC hg19.


Bioinformatics pipeline version:12.0.4
Test Limitations
1. Testing has been performed assuming that the sample received belongs to the above named individual(s) and any stated relationships between individuals are accepted as true. It is also assumed that consent for the same was provided after pre-test counseling at the point of collection/referral.
2. The current results are based on analysis of the specified region/exons based on previous report/clinicians request.
3. The test methodology currently does not detect large deletions/duplications, triplet repeat expansions and epigenetic changes. The test also does not include analysis of predictors for multifactorial, polygenic and/or complex diseases. Novel synonymous changes as well as intronic mutations (excluding those affecting invariant splice nucleotides) are not routinely reported.
4. Phenotype variability may be due to modifying genetic/non-genetic factors and is not a part of the current analysis.
5. This test has been performed in our outsource partner lab.
